name: PerifaCon
blurb: Brazil's first 'favela comic con', a free nerd and geek culture convention in Sao Paulo built by and for the periphery, with cosplay, comics, games and music.

last.venue: Fábrica de Cultura Jardim São Luís

notes: The 5th edition ran Oct 25-26, 2025 at Fabrica de Cultura Jardim Sao Luis, Sao Paulo -- already finished well before today (2026-10-05) -- and neither the official site (re-checked fresh 2026-10-05, still headlined 'PERIFACON 2025 ... 25 E 26 DE OUTUBRO') nor press coverage (Alternativa Nerd, GuetoGeek, Terra) mention a 6th edition or any date past 2025, so the 5th edition is recorded as "last" instead of an upcoming edition. The Instagram account (@perifacon) is still active with posts as recent as Sept 28, 2026, so the organization is ongoing, but post captions are not readable without a login and none of the visible image alt-text names a new edition date, so no upcoming edition is recorded. Cover uses the site's own logo (an og:image sponsor-logo strip and a crowd/stock-style hero image were both avoided per the cover rules).
